item.title: YouTube invites creators to use Gemini tool to make video games
item.description: As gaming platforms like Roblox become video hubs, YouTube is engaging in a bit of tit-for-tat. item.description: YouTube and Billboard can't agree on the best way to count digital viewership for the latter company's pop music rankings, so YouTube is taking its proverbial ball and going home. item.title: Tribeca Film Festival formall invites social media creators to hit the big screen
item.description: As social media creators become major players in Hollywood, Tribeca is officially recognizing their work. The company behind the annual Tribeca Film Festival has announced that social stars will be formally invited to present their work in the Tribeca N.O.W. category. item.title: The U.S. TikTok deal is official. Here’s what we know.
item.description: An internal memo sent to TikTok employees has confirmed a rumor that has been swirling for months: ByteDance is about to sell the U.S. version of its social video app to a White House-approved ownership group. In the memo, which was viewed by Axios, TikTok CEO Shou Zi Chew told his staff that TikTok U.S. will be sold to a consortium led by tech company Oracle, private equity firm Silver Lake, and Emerati-backed investors at MGX.
